# AntiPC AntiPC | Minecraft Bedrock Edition | Nukkit | API 1.0.13 --- **Description:**
> * Players on a `PC` (computer) cannot enter the server without a license. --- ***Features:***
:star: You can `give` a player a PC-license with the `/antipc ` command;
:star: You can `disable` PC-license with the `/antipc ` command;
:star: You can `use /antipc` command in `Console`;
:star: `Unlicensed` players will be `kicked` with a `custom message` (edit in config);
:star: `Config`;
--- **Installation:**
:black_square_button: Place plugin's .jar file into `plugins` folder on your server;
:black_square_button: `Configure` in Config;
:black_square_button: `Launch` the server;
--- **Usage:**
:unlock: To get help type `/antipc` into the chat;
--- **all Information** | Command | Permission | Descripton | config | | --- | ------|-----| -------| |antipc| reyd.antipc |It allows you to give/take license from Players|Support| --- **Examples** ![Screenshot_317](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/86683320/163117958-28ef69f8-6a7b-44bb-9f59-9de7f4941a54.png) --- ![Screenshot_318](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/86683320/163118069-85da013d-9436-4db4-9cff-ec3ae15a3056.png) --- > * Link to cloudburstmc article -> [CloudburstMC](https://cloudburstmc.org/resources/antipc.799/) --- ``` Reporting bugs: If you come across a bug, please report it here or on cloudburstmc. ```
